explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 6 configurations over 2 sweeps (no-pipeline, pipelined), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 16 GPUs.
1x TP16 + EP (max seqs 256), from the no-pipeline sweep, reached 245.63 tok/s/GPU (3930.1 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 256 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
1x TP16 + EP (max seqs 256) at concurrency 256. 17 of 24 runs held the SLOs.

prose: The no-pipeline control at 16-way tensor parallelism; a pipelined arm has to beat this at the same footprint and load to be worth its boundaries.
